sourceDescription: Noisy audience chatting and cheering at the beginning of the show. Here we are in the most famous classic theatre hall in Paris (France), called La Commédie française, just before a junior national reading contest. I’m recording from the balcony located on the right side of the hall, so the audience is in front of me, and the stage on the right. First, one can hear the noisy and excited crowd (adults and children) chatting lively.
